note: 懒得自己下矿,让玩家去金矿里找回他丢的镐子;也负责介绍熔炼之触附魔和深层洞穴。

messages.raw: §fWhoops! I lost my good pickaxe again in the mines. That's why I always come prepared with a backup!
messages.text: Whoops! I lost my good pickaxe again in the mines. That's why I always come prepared with a backup!
messages.zh: 哎呀! 我那把好镐子又丢在矿里了。所以我才总是随身多带一把备用的!

messages.raw: §fIt's probably down in the mine somewhere. Can you go find it?
messages.text: It's probably down in the mine somewhere. Can you go find it?
messages.zh: 它八成还在矿里的某个角落。你能帮我找回来吗?

messages.raw: §fMaybe one day I'll go back down there.
messages.text: Maybe one day I'll go back down there.
messages.zh: 说不定哪天我会自己下去一趟。

messages.raw: §fI'd go mining but I'm too lazy.
messages.text: I'd go mining but I'm too lazy.
messages.zh: 我倒是想去挖矿,可我太懒了。

messages.raw: §fFind my pickaxe in the Gold Mine! I'm not going back down there...
messages.text: Find my pickaxe in the Gold Mine! I'm not going back down there...
messages.zh: 去金矿里找我那把镐子! 我可不想再下去了……

messages.raw: §fSmelting Touch is a really useful enchantment. It automatically smelts ores into ingots!
messages.text: Smelting Touch is a really useful enchantment. It automatically smelts ores into ingots!
messages.zh: 「熔炼之触」是个非常好用的附魔。它能把矿石自动熔炼成锭!

messages.raw: §fCollect iron and gold ingots with that pickaxe you found!
messages.text: Collect iron and gold ingots with that pickaxe you found!
messages.zh: 用你找到的那把镐子去收集铁锭和金锭吧!

messages.raw: §f...Or do it the long way and smelt the ore yourself.
messages.text: ...Or do it the long way and smelt the ore yourself.
messages.zh: ……要不然就走老路子,自己一块块烧。

messages.raw: §fThe Deep Caverns are full of strange creatures and expensive treasures.
messages.text: The Deep Caverns are full of strange creatures and expensive treasures.
messages.zh: 深层洞穴里满是奇怪的生物和值钱的宝藏。

messages.raw: §fReach Mining Level V to gain access!
messages.text: Reach Mining Level V to gain access!
messages.zh: 挖矿等级到 5 级就能进去了!

messages.text: Have you spelunked the Deep Caverns?
messages.zh: 你去深层洞穴探过险了吗?

messages.raw: §fThey are full of bountiful treasures but watch out for those Lapis Zombies!
messages.text: They are full of bountiful treasures but watch out for those Lapis Zombies!
messages.zh: 那儿宝藏多得是,不过小心那些青金石僵尸!

messages.raw: §fIt's §7%s§f, my resting day! I earned myself a little treat, maybe you could bring me some chocolate?
messages.text: It's %s, my resting day! I earned myself a little treat, maybe you could bring me some chocolate?

segments.text: , my resting day! I earned myself a little treat, maybe you could bring me some chocolate?
segments.zh: ,我的休息日! 我得犒劳犒劳自己,你能不能给我带点巧克力来?

messages.raw: §fMmh! This is really good! I'll be sure to come back again when I'm no longer busy!
messages.text: Mmh! This is really good! I'll be sure to come back again when I'm no longer busy!
messages.zh: 唔! 这个真好吃! 等我不忙了一定再来!

messages.raw: §fThat's really unfortunate, I'll just come back again on my next resting day!
messages.text: That's really unfortunate, I'll just come back again on my next resting day!
messages.zh: 那真是太可惜了,那我下个休息日再来吧!
